items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: I really got to get together with Sidney on the, uh, studying with him through Mesmesro

ctx.x: And had a Cafe Uptown one too. They had two of them going.
Yeah. Cafe Society Uptown and Downtown too, yeah. Yeah. Uh, I'm trying to think, the first time I heard Sidney Bechet was...
Yeah, I was going to ask if you can remember.
